# Shared restart-rebuild cases (Phase 6c; docs/PLAN_PHASE6.md sections 4 and 9; rules in nnfx_ref/recovery.py).
# Run by tests/python/test_recovery.py and MQL5/Scripts/NNFX/NNFX_RecoveryTest.mq5.
# Every expected line is worked out by hand from the rules; the code must produce exactly these lines.
#
# CASE|name                  starts a case; END ends it
# MAGIC|n  PERIOD|seconds  UPTO|last processed candle (open time)  IGNORE_COMMENTS|0/1
# STATE|present|absent|corrupt    STRADE|<the 15 TRADE fields>  (the state file's trades; ignored unless present)
# POS|pos|sym|magic|dir|volume|price|sl|tp|comment                         (open positions now)
# DEAL|deal|time|pos|sym|magic|IN/OUT|dir|volume|price|reason|comment      (deal history)
# CANDLE|sym|time|close|atr|side|c1                                        (closed candles; side = close vs baseline)
# EXP|<expected canonical line>   (all of them, in order: TRADE lines by id, then CONT lines by symbol)
# NOTE|<text a rebuild note must contain>
#
# Common story: T0001 long EURUSD, decided on the 09:00 candle (ATR 0.002), filled 10:00:05 at 1.10000,
# two halves of 0.33 (positions 11 and 12), stop 1.5 x 0.002 = 1.09700, TP1 1.10200. Candles go up, all
# closes above the baseline and C1 long unless a case says otherwise.

# R1: both halves open before TP1. Trade from the broker, ATR and cap (off) from the state file.
# Continuation: trend long since the 10:00 entry candle, armed, C1 never against, no exit yet.
CASE|r1_before_tp1
MAGIC|26999
PERIOD|3600
UPTO|2026.06.02 11:00
IGNORE_COMMENTS|0
STATE|present
STRADE|T0001|EURUSD|1|11|12|1|1|0.33|1.1|1.1|0.002|-1|1.097|0|0
POS|11|EURUSD|26999|1|0.33|1.1|1.097|1.102|NNFX T0001 h1
POS|12|EURUSD|26999|1|0.33|1.1|1.097|0|NNFX T0001 h2
DEAL|101|2026.06.02 10:00:05|11|EURUSD|26999|IN|1|0.33|1.1|EXPERT|NNFX T0001 h1
DEAL|102|2026.06.02 10:00:05|12|EURUSD|26999|IN|1|0.33|1.1|EXPERT|NNFX T0001 h2
CANDLE|EURUSD|2026.06.02 09:00|1.0995|0.002|1|1
CANDLE|EURUSD|2026.06.02 10:00|1.1005|0.002|1|1
CANDLE|EURUSD|2026.06.02 11:00|1.1015|0.002|1|1
EXP|TRADE|T0001|EURUSD|1|11|12|1|1|0.33|1.1|1.1|0.002|-1|1.097|0|0
EXP|CONT|EURUSD|1|1|0|0|2026.06.02 10:00
NOTE|state file: present
END

# R2: TP1 filled at 11:30:20 (deal reason TP), half 2 at breakeven 1.10000. Closes 1.1030 and 1.1035 are less
# than 2 x 0.002 beyond 1.10000, so the trail is not on.
CASE|r2_after_tp1_breakeven

PERIOD|3600

IGNORE_COMMENTS|0

DEAL|101|2026.06.02 10:00:05|11|EURUSD|26999|IN|1|0.33|1.1|EXPERT|NNFX T0001 h1
DEAL|102|2026.06.02 10:00:05|12|EURUSD|26999|IN|1|0.33|1.1|EXPERT|NNFX T0001 h2
DEAL|103|2026.06.02 11:30:20|11|EURUSD|26999|OUT|1|0.33|1.102|TP|[tp 1.10200]

CANDLE|EURUSD|2026.06.02 12:00|1.103|0.002|1|1
CANDLE|EURUSD|2026.06.02 13:00|1.1035|0.002|1|1

END

# A stale state file (saved before TP1: both open, stop 1.097, TP1 not done) disagrees with the broker
# (TP1 filled, half 2 at breakeven): the broker wins and each disagreement is noted.
CASE|state_file_stale_broker_wins
MAGIC|26999
PERIOD|3600
UPTO|2026.06.02 13:00
